evidence.reason: At the current tip the renderer still locates the directive with `line.startswith('ExecStart=')` and then rejects unless exactly one match is found (current lines 465-467). systemd permits whitespace around the `=` in a directive, so a valid `ExecStart = ...` line produces zero matches and raises `unit must have exactly one ExecStart` despite there being exactly one ExecStart directive. This is an ordinary parser bug in the existing validation behavior, not a new requirement; exact-one validation and continuation handling can remain while recognizing valid whitespace.
